data.summary:
Results-driven Business Analyst and Certified Scrum Product Owner (CSPO) with 10+ years of experience in the Banking
domain. Skilled in bridging business and technology across Product Management, Product Ownership, Business Analysis,
Project Management, and Scrum Master functions. Expertise in requirement gathering, product backlog management,
stakeholder engagement, process optimization, and Agile/SAFe delivery. Proven record of leading large-scale banking
transformations — including Core-Banking API development and ORMB migration — with measurable impact on efficiency,
billing accuracy, and on-time delivery.

raw_sections.experience:
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE
Senior Business Analyst Capgemini — Pune December 2021 – Present
Project 1: Core-Banking API Development
Served as the primary Business Analyst and Product Owner for a Core-Banking API initiative, driving end-to-end delivery
from requirements through production deployment.
Product Ownership: Developed and managed a prioritized product backlog aligned with business objectives;
decomposed epics into actionable user stories and sprint backlogs to ensure timely delivery of high-value features.
Business Analysis: Facilitated requirement-gathering workshops, interviews, and end-to-end sessions with business
stakeholders to define scope, feasibility, and acceptance criteria.
API Documentation: Authored Swagger (JSON/OpenAPI) API specifications, reducing development delays by 25% and
accelerating engineering team kick-offs through clear, standardized documentation.
Project Planning: Developed project plans covering scope definition, resource requirements, timeline estimation, and risk
analysis to drive on-time delivery.
Stakeholder Bridge: Acted as the liaison between business stakeholders and development teams, ensuring shared
understanding of requirements and resolving ambiguities proactively.
Scrum Master: Facilitated all Scrum ceremonies — Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups, Sprint Reviews, and Sprint
Retrospectives — driving team collaboration, velocity, and continuous improvement.
Release & Deployment: Managed end-to-end product releases in coordination with development and QA teams;
monitored post-release performance and triaged bugs to ensure minimal end-user disruption.
Cost & Timeline Estimation: Delivered cost estimates for in-scope APIs and release timelines, ensuring stakeholder
alignment with business priorities.
Project 2: Germany Legacy-to-ORMB Migration (Oracle Revenue Management & Billing)
Led the business analysis and product ownership activities for Germany's transition from legacy banking systems to the
ORMB platform.
Data Migration: Oversaw migration of customer and account data from legacy systems to ORMB with zero data loss,
ensuring data integrity and seamless system transition.
Pricing & Billing: Designed and implemented standard and exception pricing setups, improving billing accuracy by 15%
and reducing revenue leakage.
Process Optimization: Partnered with business stakeholders and architects to design inbound/outbound file structures,
cutting processing time by 20% and improving operational efficiency.
Multilingual Deliverables: Developed invoice templates in English and German, enhancing customer satisfaction and
ensuring regional compliance.
Financial Reporting: Delivered critical financial reports (Product Revenue Report, Customer Account Revenue Report)
enabling data-driven leadership decisions.
Requirements Engineering: Conducted requirement-gathering sessions using interviews, workshops, brainstorming, and
focus groups; authored and maintained BRD, FRD, user stories, acceptance criteria, and process flowcharts.
Cross-functional Collaboration: Streamlined communication between cross-functional teams and stakeholders,
achieving a 25% reduction in project turnaround time.
Global Integration: Collaborated with senior architects to design custom file solutions ensuring global standards
alignment and seamless system integration.
Business Analyst State Bank of Mauritius (SBM) — Mumbai December 2019 – December 2021
Project 1: PAN Card Integration — Finacle Banking Application
Gathered and documented requirements for PAN card field integration into Finacle, improving regulatory compliance and
data accuracy.
Coordinated with Infosys and business stakeholders to design, test, and deploy the feature within agreed timelines.
Project 2: Mass Screening via Compass — Compliance Verification
Led regulatory compliance checks on bulk customer uploads via Compass, achieving 100% compliance and timely
processing.
Designed and validated UAT test scenarios; secured formal business sign-off.
Key Responsibilities — SBM
Processed and managed SWIFT payments and MT messages (MT103, MT202, MT202COV) facilitating secure, efficient
cross-border transactions.
Applied knowledge of SWIFT MT/MX message types (ISO 20022) and SEPA payment products including SCT, SDD, and
Instant SCT.
Gathered, documented, and translated business requirements into user stories, acceptance criteria, and actionable project
plans.
Conducted competitive analysis and gap analysis (AS-IS & TO-BE) to identify and recommend fit-for-purpose business
solutions.
Managed product backlog prioritization and participated in full Agile ceremony cycle: Sprint Planning, Daily Stand-ups,
Sprint Reviews, and Retrospectives.
Served as primary point of contact for project activities, coordinating with delivery managers and SMEs to ensure timely
delivery.
Business Analyst Deutsche Bank Group — Pune September 2015 – December 2019
Project: Ko-fax Compliance Application — Operations Team
Led end-to-end implementation of the Ko-fax Compliance application, reducing manual effort by 30% and improving
compliance accuracy.
Facilitated UAT, gathered feedback, and coordinated iterative improvements to meet business and regulatory
requirements.
• Conducted regulatory compliance checks on bulk customer uploads ensuring 100% adherence to compliance standards
within defined TAT.
Collaborated with cross-functional teams to integrate the application into existing workflows, reducing processing errors
and enhancing operational efficiency.
Provided post-implementation support ensuring smooth user adoption and long-term solution sustainability.
